subject: Lightbridge AI trial: success criteria & ownership (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@lightbridge.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@lightbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lightbridge trial: documented call takeaways + next steps

Thanks for the time this morning — quick recap and proposed next steps from the call so we have alignment before we scope the trial.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood inference for Lightbridge's summarization pipeline at production scale (latency-sensitive UX, cost targets).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for 512-token prompts at 8 concurrent users (target 200ms ideal).
- Throughput: baseline 40 QPS sustained for short bursts (90s) with autoscale to 80 QPS.
- Cost: token cost target <= $0.0025 per input+output token (inclusive of batching gains).
- Quality: automatically-measured ROUGE-L on your test set >= 0.78; manual QA pass-rate >= 88% on a 200-sample blind set.

Data & test artifacts we requested
- 1k representative rows (anonymized) + a 200-sample evaluation set annotated with expected summary length/labels. (Attachment: lightbridge-sample-1000rows.csv)

Timeline (suggested)
- May 28: Redwood receives sample + eval rubric.
- Jun 3: baseline run (no quantization) + initial metrics.
- Jun 10: optimized run (batching + quantization), follow-up readout.

Owners / contacts
- Redwood: Olga (trial owner), Ben (infrastructure + SLOs), Jordan (integration / SDK).
- Lightbridge: Alex (product), Maya (data).

Open items / asks for Lightbridge
1) Confirm the success criteria above or propose edits.
2) Share the sample CSV and brief eval rubric by EOD May 28.
3) Confirm procurement path if we need an MSA / trial contract for dedicated capacity.

Thanks — I’ll draft a short PoC scope doc once we lock criteria.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
oli@redwood.ai

Attachment: lightbridge-sample-1000rows.csv
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@lightbridge.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@lightbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-25T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightbridge trial: documented call takeaways + next steps

Thanks, Olga — that aligns well with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: p95 <= 250ms is acceptable; we’ll aim to prioritize UX for the shorter prompts.
- Throughput: the product team expects steady-state 45 QPS, spikes to 70 QPS during nightly sync windows — the autoscale to 80 QPS is helpful.
- Cost: your $0.0025/token target is within range for our finance team to review; can you include a conservative estimate for peak costs?

We’ll get the anonymized 1k sample and the 200-sample annotated set over to you by EOD May 28. Procurement: procurement@lightbridge.ai (CC’d) will start the paperwork — they typically ask for an SOW + standard trial addendum.

Also looping in Sarah (product ops) directly in procurement thread once she’s available.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Product, Lightbridge AI
alex.morgan@lightbridge.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-26T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: infra checklist & SLO plan for Lightbridge PoC

Internal note — capturing infra items against the proposed criteria so we don’t miss anything: 

Runbook requirements
- Baseline cluster configuration for initial run: 4x A10G equivalent GPUs, model shard pinned to GPU, KV-cache warming enabled.
- Batching policy: adaptive batching with target latency cap 200ms; max batch size 32.
- Caching: prefix-KV enabled for repeated prompt prefixes.

Measurement plan
- Instrument p50/p95/p99 over 1hr steady-state and during 90s spike test.
- Token accounting: record input/output tokens and per-minute cost estimate.
- Quality checks: automated ROUGE-L pipeline against submitted 200-sample set + a 200-sample manual QA rubric (owner: Olga).

Owners
- Infra & autoscale tests: Ben.
- SDK integration & on-call: Jordan.
- Trial metrics dashboard + readout: Olga.

Proposed trial dates (internal)
- Jun 3: baseline run (no quant)
- Jun 9: spike test + report
- Jun 10–11: optimization pass (quantization/batching) + final readout week of Jun 14 if data is ready.

I’ll prepare the infra ticket with required instance reservations and a quick cost estimate for Alex to share with finance.

—Ben
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@lightbridge.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@lightbridge.ai>
Date: 2027-05-27T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightbridge trial: documented call takeaways + next steps

Folks — attaching the anonymized sample and a short rubric for the 200-sample manual QA. We redacted PII and removed long-form logs that aren’t needed.

Attachment: lightbridge-sample-1000rows.csv
Attachment: poc-scope-checklist.xlsx

Notes on dataset and eval expectations:
- Samples vary in prompt length; mean input tokens ≈ 220, mean expected summary length ≈ 60 tokens.
- We will accept ROUGE-L >= 0.78 but will prioritize human QA on cases where summaries truncate important details.
- We can provide additional edge-case examples if you want a stress set.

Procurement: procurement@lightbridge.ai will be in touch about a short trial addendum; they prefer DocuSign.

—Maya
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@lightbridge.ai>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@lightbridge.ai>, procurement@lightbridge.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-28T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lightbridge trial: documented call takeaways + next steps — confirmed scope + action items

Great — thanks for the sample and rubric. Confirming final scope and owners below so procurement has what it needs for the trial addendum.

Final success metrics (locked):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms (target 200ms) for 512-token prompts.
- Throughput: steady-state 45 QPS, autoscale to 80 QPS for 90s spikes.
- Cost: target <= $0.0025/token (we will provide a conservative peak estimate in the infra ticket).
- Quality: ROUGE-L >= 0.78 on the 200-sample set + manual QA pass-rate >= 88%.

Action owner table (short):
- Share data + rubric (completed): Maya (Lightbridge).
- Baseline run (Jun 3): Ben (Redwood infra).
- Integration + SDK check (by Jun 1): Jordan (Redwood).
- Trial contract / addendum (next steps): procurement@lightbridge.ai -> contact: Tina (cc’d once procurement thread opens).
- Readout + recommendation (Jun 14): Olga (Redwood) + Alex (Lightbridge).

Next steps for procurement: please send the trial addendum to olga.petrov@redwood.ai and cc procurement@lightbridge.ai. We will countersign and return via DocuSign.

If anything changes to the dataset or timeline, flag immediately — otherwise we’ll proceed to schedule the baseline run for Jun 3.

—Olga
(end of thread)
